relationToSealedStudies: NONE. This is an operational decision policy assembled from existing production components. It is not an extension, rerun, amendment or rescue of kr-alpha-atlas Phase C, Phase D, kr-integrated-alpha-portfolio-v1, kr-model-overlay-portfolio-v1, benchmark-relative-alpha-v1 or any other sealed study, and it changes none of their verdicts.
preOutcomeDisclosure: This file and docs/weekly-passive-first-v1.md were committed BEFORE the policy's own historical path (rule P1 and the cash-to-benchmark re-accounting C2 below) was computed.

The author HAD already seen: every previously published study on replay-v16 (all of which failed to beat the matched benchmark after costs), and the production calibration on the full replay-v16 ledger as of 2026-10-10, in which the alpha ordering is NOT established in either region (KR rank-IC t 0.68, top-minus-bottom t 1.42; US rank-IC t 0.17, top-minus-bottom t 0.61), so every bucket is unusable. The live rule is therefore expected to hold 100% of each regional benchmark today. The historical replay is outcome-exposed descriptive evidence, never confirmation.
No parameter below was chosen from a historical return. Every number is inherited from an existing file and the source is named next to it.

rule.decisionCadence: WEEKLY: the last completed exchange session of each ISO week, per region, from that region's own exchange calendar
rule.candidatePool: The production long-term research sleeve of that region (longterm.build picks; in replay PV._research_candidates, which calls the same longterm.select_names). Regions are decided independently; no cross-region ranking, pooling or FX input.
rule.edgeSource: historical_calibration.calibrate, the production function, at horizon 126 sessions. A candidate's edge is calibratedExpectedExcessReturnPct of its region x alphaPercentile bucket, used ONLY when the bucket is usable (ordering established for the region AND enough effective spread dates). Otherwise the edge is NOT_AVAILABLE, never zero.
rule.switchCost: Round trip of the stock (dated REALISTIC_COSTS in pipeline/benchmark_alpha.py: commission both legs + full spread + dated sell tax) plus round trip of the benchmark ETF leg it displaces (commission both legs + full spread; KR sell tax 0 because domestic equity ETFs are exempt from the securities transaction tax; US uses the same 0.30bp regulatory-fee proxy as stocks).
eligibility: entry/research state multiplier > 0 (kelly_portfolio._state_multiplier: POSITIVE research view, not EVENT_RISK/AVOID, not data-insufficient, not value trap)
rule.ranking: (netAdvantage + retentionCredit) / (downside risk in pp) x state multiplier, the benchmark_alpha.challenger_scores form. retentionCredit equals the switch cost for a name held in the previous receipt and is applied AFTER the eligibility gate, so it orders but never admits.
rule.residual: 1 - 0.15 x n held in the region's benchmark ETF. 0 names = 100% benchmark. Weights always sum to 100%.
rule.staleData: If the region's latest observed session is earlier than its last completed exchange session (close + buffer), no new receipt is issued and the last valid receipt stays published with its true asOfDate.
rule.receiptIdentity: (policyVersion, region, asOfDate); append-only; a differing payload for an existing identity is refused, never overwritten

historicalComparisonProtocol.name: weekly-passive-first-v1-replay
historicalComparisonProtocol.inputs: Frozen replay-v16 inputs on signal-history (input manifest sha256 f0781292f508a123c234ded6d28aa8e84a0dc3cc29500e14989dc0b68f53b4d2, through 2026-09-14), the replay-v16 historical signal and outcome ledgers, and docs/results/regional-standalone-paths.json.gz (sealed regional CHAMPION paths).
historicalComparisonProtocol.calendar: replay_calendar.schedule('2013-01-01', through, 21, 'W'): the existing fixed 21-session anchor calendar, 155 matured blocks. The live policy decides weekly; the frozen replay ledger and valuation calendar exist only on 21-session anchors, so the replay re-decides every 21 sessions. This cadence difference is part of the result, not hidden.
historicalComparisonProtocol.pointInTime: At each anchor the calibration is recomputed with historical_calibration.calibrate on outcomes whose 126-session endDate is on or before the anchor's signalDate. The probability-calibration block inside calibrate is not computed in the replay because the rule never reads it; the replay asserts that its bucket output on the full ledger equals the production call's.
historicalComparisonProtocol.valuation: replay_valuation.ValuationData.window (production replay engine): daily marks, official closures, corporate-action successors; a held name with no valid mark makes the block INCOMPLETE and the path PARTIAL. Nothing is zero-filled or last-priced.
historicalComparisonProtocol.costs: The same dated cost table as switchCost, charged on every traded weight at each anchor, including the initial purchase of the benchmark ETF for every path.

paths.P0: Passive: 100% regional benchmark ETF, bought once and held.
paths.P1: weekly-passive-first-v1 rule replayed on the 21-session anchors (the operational policy).
paths.C1: Sealed regional standalone CHAMPION path (production conviction selector, cash residual at the KRW risk-free proxy), re-costed with the same dated cost table. Existing evidence, not re-selected.
paths.C2: C1's own decided weights with the residual held in the regional benchmark instead of cash, re-valued through the same engine. A descriptive comparison of the fallback asset only; not an operational policy.

metrics: first-half / second-half split at the median block
share of anchors with zero names
historicalComparisonProtocol.usHeadlineReason: alpha-opportunity-model-v3's sealed survivorship audit: 212 of 324 departed S&P 500 identities have no usable price history in replay-v16, so any US stock path is survivor-conditioned. The US replay is published as SURVIVORSHIP_BIASED_PARTIAL and is never a headline.
historicalComparisonProtocol.benchmarkDefinition: replay-v16 as-traded-close forward-accumulated index for BOTH the stocks and the benchmark (internally consistent). Phase C's corrected reconciliation shows this recipe's 069500.KS annual return exceeds the reconciled gross ETF total return by +1.11 to +4.51pp in every year 2013-2026; absolute KR levels are therefore overstated and the stock legs carry the same recipe with an unmeasured effect. KR comparisons are labelled BENCHMARK_DEFINITION_REPLAY_V16_NOT_RECONCILED.
forbidden: choosing nameWeight, maxNames, horizon, cost or any threshold from this replay
a second run with a changed rule under the same id
presenting P1, C1 or C2 as validated or as knowably best in advance
